testsuite.name: UC7 Office Visit
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: patient: The patient selects to view an office visit. They see all information the HCP recorded for the office visit. They cannot edit the information.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: Submit office
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: hcp: The HCP selects to document an office visit by recording if the office visit was prescheduled, any notes about the visit, the patient, appointment type, hospital the patient was seen at, the date, and time of the visit. They fill out a form and press Submit Office Visit .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC3 - Alternative Flow 2: Provide additional details about the
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 2: Provide additional details about the
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: hcp: The HCP provides additional details about the office visit as appropriate for the appointment type: General Checkup Basic Health Metrics (uc8)
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC4 - Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.summary: Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: patient: The patient selects to view an office visit. They see all information the HCP recorded for the office visit. They cannot edit the information.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM prompts the HCP to correct the format of a required data field because the input of that data field does not match that specified in Section 7.7 for the office visit data or for any other collected data .
